# SkillChef

> SkillChef is a local-first MCP tool that helps coding agents turn a developer task, an approved project brief, and user-approved repository context into a reviewable, reusable `SKILL.md`.

SkillChef does not read or edit a repository directly. The coding agent proposes context files; the user approves what to share and reviews sources, risk notes, and the generated skill before saving it. The website documents a local, single-owner tool, not a hosted multi-user service.

Choose either the copy-and-paste agent setup prompt or the manual MCP configuration guide. These are alternative setup methods. Model-provider selection is a separate choice. Deterministic compilation works without a model provider; semantic synthesis uses the provider configured for the local MCP process.

## Docs

- [SkillChef guide](https://grok-skills.vercel.app/): Product overview, workflow, setup choices, data boundaries, safety notes, and skill format.
- [Agent setup](https://grok-skills.vercel.app/#station): Choose between the agent prompt and manual MCP configuration.
- [Model provider setup](https://grok-skills.vercel.app/#provider-setup): Configure a hosted provider or run synthesis locally with Ollama.
- [Skill output format](https://grok-skills.vercel.app/#the-recipe): Review the generated Agent Skills file structure.
- [Data and safety boundaries](https://grok-skills.vercel.app/#contract): See what SkillChef receives, where context may be sent, and what it does not change.
